input: Set up a direct debit for the council tax bill

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Council Tax Direct Debit
gold.taskDescription: Set up a direct debit payment arrangement for the council tax bill with the relevant local authority.

questions.title: Which local council or authority do you pay?
questions.description: Identify the specific council or local authority responsible for the user's council tax.

questions.title: Have you registered for council tax at this address?
questions.description: Confirm whether the user already has an active council tax account set up.

questions.title: Do you have your council tax account number handy?
questions.description: Check whether the user has the account reference number needed to set up the direct debit.

questions.title: Which bank account should the direct debit come from?
questions.description: Identify the bank account the user wants to use for the direct debit payments.

questions.title: Which monthly payment date do you prefer?
questions.description: Determine the user's preferred payment date within the month for the direct debit.

questions.title: Do you want to pay in 10 or 12 monthly instalments?
questions.description: Clarify the instalment plan the user wants, as most councils offer either 10 or 12 monthly payments.

questions.title: Will you set this up online, by phone, or by post?
questions.description: Establish the user's preferred method for actually submitting the direct debit instruction to the council.
